key.name: servers-list
key.description: Array of hostnames or IP addresses to ping.

key.name: check-interval
key.description: Interval in seconds between ping checks.

key.name: ping-timeout
key.description: Timeout in seconds for each ping command.

key.name: work-hours-servers
key.description: List of server hostnames that should only be checked during work hours.

key.name: work-hours-start
key.description: Starting hour of office working hours (0-23 in 24-hour format).

key.name: work-hours-end
key.description: Ending hour of office working hours (0-23 in 24-hour format).

key.name: work-days-only
key.description: Whether office working hours only apply on configured working days.

key.name: work-days-type
key.description: Working days schedule: 'sun-fri' (Sunday to Friday), 'mon-fri' (Monday to Friday), 'sun-thu' (Sunday to Thursday), 'mon-sat' (Monday to Saturday), or 'all' (Every day).
